payload.title: 5513 Cutshaw Ct #1, Charlotte, NC 28215
payload.description:
Private Room in Charlotte Comfortable, Affordable Living
Looking for a place that feels more like home and less like just four walls? Welcome to Life Door Rentals where shared living meets connection, comfort, and affordability.

Our homes are designed for people who want to live simply, save money, and be around others who are respectful, independent, and like-minded. Whether you're new to town or just looking for a fresh start, this could be the perfect fit.

 The Room
*A private bedroom in a peaceful home, with a shared bathroom (private baths available).
*Rent: $675 - $1,000/month (depending on size and features)
*Lease: 12-month preferred (ask us about shorter stays!)
*Move-In: Tell us when you're looking and we'll try to match it!

 What You'll Love
*Keyless entry for safety and convenience
*Fully stocked kitchen and comfy, furnished common spaces
*Fast WiFi and all utilities included no extra bills!
*Washer and dryer in the home
*Off-street parking
*Professional maintenance team just a text away

 Who You'll Live With
 Our homes aren't just places to sleep they're communities. Everyone goes through a background check to help ensure the space stays respectful and safe. Most of our housemates are young professionals, working adults, retirees, or students looking for a quiet, affordable, and clean place to call home.
 Need-to-Knows
*This room is for one person only
*No pets and no smoking inside the home
*Not a party house ideal for those who like a quiet, low-key home
*$350 move-in fee
*No security deposit required
*Showings available by appointment only
*6-month leases available for +$50/month

 Ready to see the space? Tell us a little about yourself, your move-in date, and we'll be in touch to schedule a tour. We can't wait to welcome you home!

Lease Term:
-One-year lease
-6 months lease available for $50 more per month
 Housing Rules:
-One person per room No exceptions.
-No smoking anywhere on the property.
-No pets allowed.
-Visitor policy: Up to 5 overnight guests per-month.
-Weapons are strictly prohibited on the premises
Lease Duration: 1 year
